title: Transport an adjunction through an isomorphism of left functors
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories [def-nagata-category], let $L,L':\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be functors, let $a:L\dashv R$ be an adjunction, meaning natural bijections $a_{M,N}:\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(LM,N)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(M,RN)$, and let $e:L\xrightarrow{\sim}L'$ be a natural isomorphism. There is an adjunction $L'\dashv R$ whose Hom bijection sends $f:L'M\to N$ to $a_{M,N}(f\circ e_M)$.
